name: js-path-resolver
description: Resolves paths in Javascript objects, and provides tools to get, set, replace, or remove the resolved item
author: Steven Spungin

scripts.build: npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm && npm run build:global && npm run build:vuex && npm run build:plugin && npm run build:types
scripts.build:cjs: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=cjs --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="/*! js-path-resolver $npm_package_version | (c) 2018-present Steven Spungin | MIT */"
scripts.build:esm: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="/*! js-path-resolver $npm_package_version | (c) 2018-present Steven Spungin | MIT */"
scripts.build:global: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=jsPathResolver --minify --outfile=dist/index.global.js --banner:js="/*! js-path-resolver $npm_package_version | (c) 2018-present Steven Spungin | MIT */"
scripts.build:vuex: esbuild src/dot-path-mutations.js --bundle --format=cjs --platform=neutral --external:vue --outfile=dist/vuex.js --banner:js="/*! js-path-resolver $npm_package_version | (c) 2018-present Steven Spungin | MIT */" && esbuild src/dot-path-mutations.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --external:vue --outfile=dist/vuex.mjs --banner:js="/*! js-path-resolver $npm_package_version | (c) 2018-present Steven Spungin | MIT */"
scripts.build:plugin: esbuild src/DotPathPlugin.js --bundle --format=cjs --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/vue-plugin.js --banner:js="/*! js-path-resolver $npm_package_version | (c) 2018-present Steven Spungin | MIT */" && esbuild src/DotPathPlugin.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/vue-plugin.mjs --banner:js="/*! js-path-resolver $npm_package_version | (c) 2018-present Steven Spungin | MIT */"
